dedupe_keys.name: comprehensive life cycle assessment of a large tank thermal energy storage in a district heating system

description: The documented Linz tank-storage life-cycle assessment considers construction, operation and end of life over a 30-year study lifetime. The source reports operation as the dominant impact stage and construction below one percent in its allocation setting. A presentation explicitly names the same Linz tank case and environmental-allocation sensitivity, and is grouped as a supporting case description. A broader poster by the core authors is retained as related context without assuming that every result belongs to an identical calculation. These are bounded environmental assessment outcomes, not general performance guarantees. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
name: Comprehensive life cycle assessment of a large tank thermal energy storage in a district heating system
